We've read the Harry Potter series more times than we can count—and dissected basically every sentence along the way. But even in a series we love, something has to come in last.

Today we're picking our least favorite chapter from EACH Harry Potter book, from Philosopher's Stone all the way through Deathly Hallows.  Prepare for some Hot takes yall because YES we included “The Marauders Map” and “The Hungarian Horntail” - You have been warned!
